echoParts: you may have life in His name
verseText: But these are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in His name.
meaning: John wrote a book describing many of Jesus' miracles. He wrote it so that people would believe that Jesus was the Christ, the savior sent to rescue us from our sins.

recall.question: Why did John write down the miracles and teachings of Jesus?
choices: So people would believe in Jesus
So people would buy his book
So people would forget about Jesus

meaning.question: Christ means the Savior God promised to send. What does John say we receive by believing that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God?

application.prompt: John wrote a book telling the story of Jesus and his wonders. He did it so we could know who Jesus is and believe in Him. Every miracle and teaching gives us another reason to have confidence that Jesus really was the Savior of the World.
